title: when the paragraph is technically correct but sounds robotic
caption: When a paragraph sounds stiff, I use Clearfy to help revise the wording and then still read it myself.
pinned_comment: I would still edit the final version myself, but this helps with the stiff parts.
script_lines: when the paragraph is correct but sounds like a robot wrote it
